newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius electronic share settlement due in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius electronic share settlement due in Dec.

text.p: The central depository system (CDS) for electronic share settlement at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius will be ready by mid-December, Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam said on Wednesday.

"The government is making appropriate legal provisions for the operations of a central depository system (to be) implemented by the Stock Exchange of Mauritius. The CDS will be operational by mid-December 1996," Ramgoolam told a meeting in Port Louis.
The CDS at the Mauritius bourse was initially expected to be operational in early November but this was delayed because of a parliament vacation which will last until November 26.

"On the technical side, the system is ready and we could have started on the fifth of November. But the legal operating environment must be amended," Stock Exchange of Mauritius chairman Bruno Hardy told Reuters.
